newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading on Star Enter shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading on Star Enter shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Star Entertainment (International Holdings) Ltd was suspended pending an announcement, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said on Friday.
Shares of Star Entertainment rose steadily after the company proposed an eight rights shares for one existing share issues earlier this month.
The shares gained HK$0.66 or 122 percent this week to close at HK$1.2 on Thursday.
Brokers said investors bought the shares on speculations of possible asset injections after the cash call.
The use of proceeds for business expansion would also be positive for the company, one said.
